name: Lily Day
source:
The best person I've ever met. She's really nice and is always fun to spend time with. She doesn't let her fame go to her head. Every time I need her she is there for me. I couldn't have a better best friend if I searched the whole world.

She is vice president of the student council (second only to One-Hit-Wonder Boy). Her student council duties are mostly done during her elective class time.

[From Idril's Phone Contacts In-Game]
